summary: Iteration 4 - Series Shelf + Coordinated Cover feature testing. Backend (pytest 2/2 PASS): GET /api/books exposes serie_root_id correctly (empty on Vol.1 book_parent_test01, equals 'book_parent_test01' on sequel book_341e3efcc848 with serie_volume=2). POST /api/books/{id}/cover with use_parent_cover=true on a NON-series book returns 400 with 'Questo libro non fa parte di una serie' (verified on a freshly-created throwaway standalone book, cleaned up in finally). No AI generation triggered - test user still at 6 credits. Frontend (all UI flows PASS via Playwright): (1) Dashboard shows data-testid=series-section with shelf 'Saga di «Gli Orologi del Tempo Sospeso»', 2 volumes in order (Vol.1 book_parent_test01 then Vol.2 book_341e3efcc848), both cover images loaded (data-URI base64), Vol.1/Vol.2 badges rendered. (2) Clicking series-volume-book_341e3efcc848 navigates to /book/book_341e3efcc848. (3) Typing 'xyz' in library-search-input hides series-section; clearing restores it. (4) Selecting genre filter Fantasy (non-Tutti) hides series-section; clicking Tutti restores it. (5) On sequel BookView -> tab Copertina, data-testid=series-cover-toggle visible with parent title 'Gli Orologi del Tempo Sospeso'; clicking toggles activated state (class gains bg-[#722F37]/5 border-[#722F37]) and reverts on second click. (6) On Vol.1 parent BookView -> tab Copertina, series-cover-toggle is NOT present. All 8 requested scenarios pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx series grouping (lines 69-80): only groups books that have serie_root_id set. Books whose sequels exist but which themselves lack a serie_root_id (parent volumes) are correctly included via the roots-Set membership check - good. However groups with length<=1 are filtered out (line 78), which means a parent that has no sequel yet won't show as a shelf even if serie_volume=1; that's the intended UX.
SeriesShelf.jsx uses volumes[0].id as key (line 16) which works because volumes are pre-sorted by serie_volume; safe as long as the parent has volume=1 (or a stable id).
CoverStudio.jsx toggle uses tailwind arbitrary values with the '/5' opacity utility ('bg-[#722F37]/5') - verified rendering correctly in production build.

Backend /api/books/{id}/cover with use_parent_cover on non-series book: main agent confirmed the check happens after ensure_credits but before deduction, so it correctly does NOT consume credits on 400 - verified: seed user still shows 6 crediti after the test.
